captions.text: A packed trailer can hide the top of a carton.
Austin startup Contoro builds robots to unload boxes.
Contoro says its gripper holds two sides at once.
The front face and another accessible surface.

retime_evidence._why: A cut is placed at the start of the line its scene carries. That word's time is measured when the reader paused before it and modelled by syllable weight when they did not, so this counts both rather than claiming all are measured.

engineering_spike: Owner-requested A/B study. Not a production edition or approval.

art_direction.palette_reason: Warm cardboard identifies the one conserved load; cool steel distinguishes the moving gripper from the warehouse.

lighting.motivation: A high loading-bay work light defines carton edges; open-door fill separates the cup rims without glossy toy reflections.

art_direction.shape_language: Creased, bevelled corrugated cartons oppose broad steel plates and compliant circular cups. Avoid undifferentiated blocks.

hero.silhouette: One labeled amber carton below a heavier stack, with exposed front and outer side.
hero.finish: Authored three-face corrugated carton, tape folds, paper label, fiber, contact shadows, hardware and reflective conveyor rollers.

art_direction.focal_hierarchy: The two contact faces are the first read. Stack explains the covered top. Rail and trailer ribs stay subordinate below captions.
art_direction.motion_language: Pause before contact, quick compliant approach, slower loaded withdrawal, then hold the changed state. Camera follows one physical event.

signature_shot.reason: See the side plate meet the carton while the retained front contact establishes the two-face grip.

s1.reason: Open on the inaccessible top and visible front contact; carton and cups dominate the phone frame.

s2.reason: Reveal the whole support assembly and conveyor while preserving the one carton and both accessible faces.

s3.reason: Signature detail: identify simultaneous contact on the front and side, then follow the start of the same withdrawal.

s4.reason: Follow the conserved carton into free space; the departing stack reveals its now-accessible top and supported load.
